entities.summary: Konbaung, a notable figure in the history of Myanmar, associated with Konbaung Dynasty (1824–1885). Preceded by First Anglo-Burmese War — Burma cedes Arakan and Tenasserim to Britain and Burmese forces sack and destroy Ayutthaya, ending the Thai kingdom. Their legacy influenced Third Anglo-Burmese War — Britain annexes Upper Burma and exiles King Thibaw.
